rules: Graph divergence is not semantic obsolescence.
Historical PASS does not transfer across material head movement or restack.
SUPERSEDED preserves provenance and does not itself close the PR.
HISTORICAL_PRESERVATION is evidence/history only and grants no current authority.
REVIEW_BLOCKED means source may remain useful but cannot be treated as current-main-ready.
EFFECT_BLOCKED means remaining live closure requires protected/external effect after source prerequisites.
